title: Local-only progress tracking (browser storage, opt-in, no server/PII)
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). Progress tracking helps learners know where they left off and what they have completed. The project's no-PII and no-account stance requires that any tracking be entirely local (browser localStorage), opt-in with clear consent messaging, and never transmit learner data to any server.
objective: Add opt-in, local-only progress tracking that stores exercise completion status in the learner's own browser storage, shows the learner their progress across the curriculum, and is removable on demand — with no server transmission and no PII collection.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress tracking is opt-in: learners see a clear consent message before any data is stored; the site is fully usable without opting in.
All progress data is stored exclusively in browser localStorage; no data is transmitted to any server.
Tracked data is limited to: exercise completion status (pass/fail) and lesson visit history — no learner code, no timestamps with PII potential.
Learners can view their stored progress and delete it entirely from within the site UI.
Privacy notice is shown in the tracking UI, explaining what is stored and that it stays on the device.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass.
output: A merged PR adding opt-in, local-only progress tracking with consent UI, localStorage-backed storage, and a delete-all option — no server data transmission.
